name: Ayanna Everstride
summary: In Shadowglen, Ayanna Everstride trains young kaldorei in the hunter’s way. Stationed in Aldrassil, she teaches marksmanship, tracking, and survival beneath the World Tree.

sections.title: A Mentor in Shadowglen
sections.body: Ayanna Everstride trains newly awakened kaldorei hunters inside Aldrassil, in the heart of Shadowglen. To the night elves, hunters are indispensable guardians of the sacred forests, not merely trappers or sharpshooters. Ayanna teaches novices early martial skills, ranged combat, and how to survive Teldrassil’s perilous woods.

faq.answer: Ayanna Everstride trains novice night elf hunters in Aldrassil, within Shadowglen on Teldrassil. She teaches basic combat and outdoor survival skills.

faq.q: Where can I find Ayanna Everstride?
faq.answer: You can find Ayanna Everstride inside Aldrassil, the massive hollowed tree settlement in Shadowglen, at the heart of Teldrassil.
Early training sends new night elf hunters to Ayanna. Their first instructors may give them an Etched Sigil, and Ayanna then provides introductory training for aspiring woodland rangers.

angles.text: As a hunter starting in Shadowglen, you can look to Ayanna Everstride for your first guidance in weapon handling, tracking, and wilderness survival.
As a night elf, you find Ayanna within Aldrassil’s sacred hollows. She prepares raw recruits to defend the surrounding forest from encroaching corruption and help safeguard the young World Tree.
